title: Finding
description: One finding in the reviewer's findings schema, version 3: the seven required fields. Open to extension: a schema that adds fields references this one and closes it with unevaluatedProperties. A review.* finding never carries CRITICAL.

path.description: Path relative to the module root with forward slashes, or . for the module root. No absolute path, no backslash, no .. segment.

explains.description: The behaviour difference ids a finding explains, each '<trigger id>|<level>|<case id>|<attribute>' as claims-eval lists them in outstanding. Only on a compat.expression-behaviour-changed or claim.* finding.

evidence_digest.description: The claims-eval evidence_digest of the trigger whose differences the finding explains. Only on a compat.expression-behaviour-changed or claim.* finding.

explaining_rule.description: A rule whose findings may carry explains and evidence_digest.
